info.title: AnyDag sync API
info.description:
`anydag-api`: end-to-end-encrypted sync, opt-in anonymous logs and the feedback relay, one Node process anybody can run (`api/` in the AnyDag repository).

The server holds opaque keys, sealed blobs and sealed metadata, and never a path or a byte of a file: a `key` is an HMAC of a path, a blob id an HMAC of the bytes, a `meta` and a vault's `name` are sealed, all base64url.

`info.version` is the sync protocol, 2. Every request to a route that lists the `anydag-sync-protocol` header must send it, and every `/v1` answer says it back. A refusal is `{code, message}` at the status its `ES_*` code has, whatever the route; branch on the code.

Generated from the code (`api/server/openapi.ts`, `api/protocol/schema.ts`): do not edit it by hand.

get.summary: Hear about commits as they land
get.description: A server-sent event stream: `data: {"seq":N}` after each commit to the vault and a `: ping` comment every 20 s. It carries a number and nothing else: a client reads `changes` either way, so a lost poke costs a poll interval, never a change.

parameters.description: The vault's id: ten characters of lower-case Crockford base32.

post.description: Open: an install that sends logs is usually not a device of this server. A batch over the size cap, the per-address rate or the server's is answered `{accepted: 0}` and dropped, never an error a client would retry; one that is not JSON is `ES_BAD_REQUEST`.

post.summary: Send a bug or an idea, made a GitHub issue
post.description: Stateless: nothing of it is kept. Every file is uploaded before the issue is made, so a failed upload makes no issue. Five a minute an address, sixty in all.

PairRequest.description: A pairing code, and the device it pairs. The code is read as a person types it: any case, dashes and spaces ignored.

current.description: In `GET /v1/devices`: whether this is the device asking.

conflicts.description: `ES_STALE`: every key whose parent was wrong, with its head.

missing.description: `ES_NO_BLOB`: the blob ids the server lacks.

horizon.description: `ES_HORIZON`: the lowest `seq` still in the log.

ErrorBody.description: Every refusal: branch on `code`; `message` is for a person.

head.description: The head's `seq`, `null` when the key has never existed.

blob.description: The head's blob, `null` when it is a delete or there is none.

StaleKey.description: In `ES_STALE`: where a key's head really is.

seq.description: The last `seq` assigned: 0 for a vault nothing was committed to.

keyed.description: Whether its key was set: a vault with none is an upload that never finished.

RemoteVault.description: A remote vault. Its `name` is sealed under the vault's own key.

CreateVault.description: A new vault's sealed name, and optionally the id the device's own vault already has, kept when it is free.

VaultKey.description: The vault key, sealed under the passphrase's key and under the recovery key, with the KDF that opens the first.

KdfParams.description: How the passphrase's key is derived.

wrapped.description: The vault key sealed under the passphrase's key.

recovery.description: The vault key sealed under the recovery key.

PutVaultKey.description: The vault key, sealed twice. Replacing a key takes its current `etag`.

Report.description: Counts a client saw, for the usage ledger only. A count left out or `null` is 0.

AccountInfo.description: The device's account, its plan and what it uses.

storage_bytes.description: Live bytes plus bytes uploaded and never committed.

history_bytes.description: Superseded history kept, in sealed bytes. `null` is `storage_bytes`, and unlimited only when that is null too.

Plan.description: A plan's limits; every `null` is unlimited.

BlobStored.description: The blob is held, at this size: a second upload of an id the server holds is answered the same.

CommitRequest.description: Up to 1000 changes, no key twice, accepted whole or refused whole.

parent.description: The `seq` of the head this change was based on — a delete's too — or `null` for a key that has never had one.

blob.description: The new content's blob, or `null` for a delete.

meta.description: Sealed with this change's key, blob and parent inside it.

CommitResponse.description: The `seq` given to each change, in order.

next.description: The cursor to ask with next: the last `seq` returned, or `since` when none was.

more.description: Whether more entries are waiting past `next`.

horizon.description: The lowest `seq` still in the log.

size.description: The sealed blob's size in bytes, 0 for a delete.

device.description: The device that committed it: a client skips its own.

LogEntry.description: A row of the log as it is read back.

next.description: The `after` to ask with next, `null` on the last page.

HeadsResponse.description: A page of heads in key order, deletes included. `seq` is the vault's last when the page was read.

parent.description: The `parent` of the change that made this head: what its sealed `meta` is bound to.

locale.description: A language, and a region when there is one.

ServerFailed.description: The server failed; the stack is on its stderr, never here.

ES_BAD_REQUEST_or_ES_PAIR.description: `ES_BAD_REQUEST`: a body or a query that does not have the shape this document gives. `ES_PAIR`: a pairing code that is unknown, used or expired.

ES_QUOTA.description: `ES_QUOTA`: over the plan: storage, a file's size, or the number of devices.

ES_PROTOCOL.description: `ES_PROTOCOL`: the request did not say sync protocol 2 in `anydag-sync-protocol`.

ES_AUTH.description: `ES_AUTH`: no device token, an unknown one, or a revoked device's.

ES_NOT_FOUND.description: `ES_NOT_FOUND`: no such vault, blob, device, account or plan.

ES_BAD_REQUEST.description: `ES_BAD_REQUEST`: a body or a query that does not have the shape this document gives.

ES_KEY_SET.description: `ES_KEY_SET`: the vault has a key, and the `etag` sent is not its current one.

ES_STALE.description: `ES_STALE`: a change's `parent` is not its key's head; nothing was written (`conflicts`).

ES_NO_BLOB.description: `ES_NO_BLOB`: a commit names a blob the server does not hold; upload first (`missing`).

ES_HORIZON.description: `ES_HORIZON`: a cursor older than the compaction horizon; read the heads (`horizon`).

ES_TOO_LARGE.description: `ES_TOO_LARGE`: feedback bigger than the relay reads.

ES_RATE.description: `ES_RATE`: over a rate: try again in a minute.

ES_UPSTREAM.description: `ES_UPSTREAM`: GitHub refused or failed; no issue was made.

ES_UNAVAILABLE.description: `ES_UNAVAILABLE`: this server has no GitHub token or repository for the relay.

ES_FORBIDDEN.description: `ES_FORBIDDEN`: not the admin token, or no admin token configured.

Protocol.description: The sync protocol this server speaks: 2.
